name: Local Vault & Codebase RAG
author: Astra Navi Contributors
description: Optional local-only hybrid semantic + BM25 search across user-approved Obsidian vaults, notes, and repositories with symlink/sensitive-path blocking and untrusted data framing.

tools.name: plugin:vault.index_status
tools.description: Report indexed file/chunk counts and approved vault roots.

tools.name: plugin:vault.search
tools.description: Run hybrid semantic + BM25 search over approved vault folders (returns outsideText passages).

tools.name: plugin:vault.reindex
tools.description: Incrementally re-hash and re-index approved vault directories.

evalCases.name: vault search allowed read-only inside approved workspace
vault search escalates to ask after outside text
